objectives.text: Apply components, props, state, effects, routing, forms and context together on short mixed problems, including every re-render trigger taught (a state update, a parent re-render and a changed context value)
Diagnose common React bugs (mutated state, a missing or unstable key, a wrong dependency array, an unhandled error status) and name the fix

minutes.basis: Measured on the authored artifact.html with the frozen estimator (authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py): P50 7.61 minutes. Worst required path models one additional wrong graded attempt per interactive unit before it settles, at the estimator cost table (1 predict at 30 s, 1 explore at 20 s, 3 terminal_step at 35 s, 2 mcq at 45 s): 11.69 minutes. Budget and about label are 12: the larger of the intake plan of 10 and ceil(max(P50, worst path)), under the 15-minute ceiling (authoring/docs/tools/validators.md). This is a model, not a measurement with learners.
